query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

per_column.name: engagement_participation
per_column.rationale: A genuine thematic axis for the query. Sample codings (cameras_off_muted, high_engagement, disengaged_dropoff) are sound readings of the source text.

per_column.name: hands_on_materials_impact
per_column.rationale: Distinct materials/labs theme, well-grounded; creative_adaptation_with_materials and not_present for silent rows are appropriate.

per_column.name: peer_interaction_community
per_column.rationale: Clear community theme. Mostly grounded; 'vibrant_community_built' for ED-0002 is a mild overreach since text only implies attendance, but defensible.

per_column.name: instructional_quality
per_column.rationale: Useful teaching-quality axis with well-supported codings across samples.

per_column.name: subject_remote_fit
per_column.rationale: Good analytical axis, but ED-0003 (reading session) coded 'poorly_suited_stem_labs' contradicts a reading/language context; some codings not warranted.

per_column.name: household_equity
per_column.rationale: Relevant equity theme; but ED-0001 coded 'parental_support_needed' and ED-0003 'materials_unavailable_home' are not supported by those texts.

per_column.name: student_wellbeing
per_column.rationale: Strong wellbeing axis; cries_before_class, anxiety_during_math, student_thriving are sound readings.

per_column.name: cognitive_depth
per_column.rationale: Useful learning-depth theme, but several codings are inferential overreach (ED-0004 'deep_conceptual_growth', ED-0001 'intuition_building_lost') not clearly stated.

per_column.name: pedagogical_innovation
per_column.rationale: Distinct innovation theme, codings largely grounded (recorded_lectures_help_pace, digital_tools_enable_new_possibility).

per_column.name: cognitive_depth_understanding
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of cognitive_depth with the same value vocabulary; adds no new analytical axis for this query.

per_column.name: instructional_quality_variation
per_column.rationale: Redundant restatement of instructional_quality with identical value set; little added leverage.

per_column.name: peer_interaction_community_loss
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of peer_interaction_community with same vocabulary; trivially redundant.

per_column.name: household_equity_gaps
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of household_equity; no new analytical axis.

per_column.name: pedagogical_innovation_success
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of pedagogical_innovation with same value set; redundant.

per_column.name: student_wellbeing_anxiety
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of student_wellbeing; furthermore ED-0001 coded 'motivation_drain' where wellbeing had 'anxiety_during_math', showing inconsistency and unsupported drift.

judge.rationale: The distinct thematic columns (engagement, materials, community, instructional quality, subject fit, equity, wellbeing, cognitive depth, innovation) form a rich, relevant set of axes for identifying themes in open responses, and most codings are sound readings of the source with appropriate 'not_present' handling for silent rows. However, roughly half the added columns are near-duplicates re-emitting the same value vocabularies as earlier columns (cognitive_depth_understanding, instructional_quality_variation, peer_interaction_community_loss, household_equity_gaps, pedagogical_innovation_success, student_wellbeing_anxiety), adding no new analytical leverage. Groundedness is generally good but weakened by inferential overreach in equity/cognitive-depth codings and a few contradictions (e.g., reading session coded as STEM lab).
